chunks: Ṣāliḥ, Abū Muqātil, al-Daylamī. He compiled a large book regarding the Imamate, (using) ḥadīth and kalām, and he named it the book of "al-Iḥtijāj".
ai.seo_question: Who authored the book Kitab al-Ihtijaj and what is its subject matter?
ai.summary: This entry from the biographical dictionary identifies Ṣāliḥ ibn Muqātil al-Daylamī as the author of a significant work titled 'Kitab al-Iḥtijāj'. The book is characterized by its comprehensive treatment of the Imamate, utilizing both prophetic traditions (ḥadīth) and theological discourse (kalām).
